data: What are the two main components involved in the swap model architecture?

The two main components involved in the swap model architecture are the stack and the buffer. These are clearly represented in the figure as two separate sections labeled "stack" and "buffer." The stack contains items 1 and 2, while the buffer contains items 3, 4, 5, and 6. The arrows indicate the movement of items between these two components, showing how the model predicts shifts and swaps.
